# Animation Anatomy Audit — Arms/Elbows Only

Legend: ✅ pass | ⚠️ minor | 🔴 defect flag

---

## IMAGE 1 — Run cycle (vx=350)

### Frame 1 (top-left, contact/drive pose)
**Sword arm:** Shoulder (chest, ~x295) → elbow (~x322, y198) → hand near chest (~x318, y212). Trace reads shoulder → elbow forward/down → hand folded back in. Elbow interior angle ≈ 95–105°. Fold direction correct (elbow forward, forearm folding back toward body). ✅
**Off arm:** Trailing, shoulder → elbow (~x275) → hand behind hip. Elbow angle ≈ 135–145°, bend forward — correct direction for back-swing. Hand is *at* the hip, not behind it. ✅ (borderline — hand nearly drifts past hip line; keep it forward next pass.)
**Asymmetry check:** Both arms valid. ✅
**Blade:** Not visible/clipped in silhouette — no leg intersection. ✅

### Frame 2 (top-right, push-off)
**Sword arm:** Shoulder → elbow (~x895) → hand folded to chest. Elbow ≈ 90–100°, correct fold. ✅
**Off arm:** Elbow slightly *above* the shoulder line (elbow dot sits higher than chest anchor on the far side). ⚠️ Elbow height ≈ shoulder height — at the limit of the "elbow higher than shoulder" defect. Flagger: **⚠️ mild — off-arm elbow cresting shoulder line.**
**Asymmetry:** Both arms plausible. ✅

### Frame 3 (bottom-left, reach/recovery) — 🔴 worst frame of the set
**Off arm:** Shoulder (~x295) → elbow (~x230, y565) → hand (~x225). The entire arm is extended straight **back and slightly up**, roughly horizontal. Elbow interior angle ≈ **165–172°** — effectively straight, brushing the hyperextension threshold. **🔴 elbow at/above shoulder height** (elbow dot is level with the chest anchor, visibly higher than the waist). **🔴 hand clearly behind the hip** during what should be forward recovery — pump phase is inverted for this arm.
**Sword arm:** Elbow forward ≈ 100°, folded correctly. ✅
**Asymmetry bug:** **🔴 one arm anatomically fine (sword arm), the other rigid/hyperextended and phase-flipped.** This is the classic single-arm IK pop.

### Frame 4 (bottom-right, airborne)
**Sword arm:** Elbow (~x875) forward-down, hand tucked. ≈ 90°. ✅
**Off arm:** Bent ≈ 110°, elbow slightly behind torso — correct for airborne tuck. ✅
**Asymmetry:** Both fine. ✅
**Blade:** Airborne, no ground contact. ✅

---

## IMAGE 2 — Sprint cycle (vx=480)

### Frame 1 (left, deep crouch drive)
**Sword arm:** Shoulder → elbow (~x315, y225) → hand forward (~x330). Elbow angle ≈ 70–80° — heavily folded but forward-correct. **⚠️ elbow is at/above shoulder height** in the crouch; acceptable for a sprint lean, but it's cresting the shoulder joint line.
**Off arm:** Nearly co-located with the sword arm — both elbows bunched at the same height, off arm barely distinguishable. **🔴 pump phase not opposite; off arm is shadowing the sword arm instead of counter-swinging.**
**Asymmetry:** **🔴 borderline broken — off arm is a compressed copy of the sword arm, not an opposing swing.**
**Blade:** None visible; no intersection. ✅

### Frame 2 (middle, drive extension)
**Sword arm:** Shoulder → elbow (~x865) → hand near chest. ≈ 95°, fold correct, elbow below shoulder. ✅
**Off arm:** Elbow (~x845) trailing, ≈ 120–130°, bending forward — correct back-swing. ✅
**Asymmetry:** This is the only frame where the counter-phase reads correctly. ✅
**Blade:** Clear. ✅

### Frame 3 (right, upright/float)
**Sword arm:** Shoulder → elbow (~x1345) → hand hanging nearly straight down. Elbow ≈ **165–170°**. **🔴 near-hyperextension — the arm has gone rigid at the side, exactly the "straight stick" IK failure.** No sprint pump at 480 px/s, where swing amplitude should be *largest*.
**Off arm:** Same — straight, dangling, ≈ 170°. **🔴 both arms dead.**
**Asymmetry:** Ironically symmetric here — both broken identically (arms frozen in a neutral bind pose leaking into the sprint clip). 🔴
**Blade:** Clear. ✅

---

## Summary of actionable defects

| # | Defect | Location |
|---|--------|----------|
| 1 | 🔴 Off arm hyperextended ~170°, hand behind hip, elbow at shoulder height | Img1, Frame 3 (bottom-left) |
| 2 | 🔴 Single-arm asymmetry bug (sword arm fine, off arm broken) | Img1, Frame 3 |
| 3 | 🔴 Off arm shadowing sword arm, no counter-phase | Img2, Frame 1 |
| 4 | 🔴 Both arms near-hyperextended, frozen/bind-pose hang | Img2, Frame 3 |
| 5 | ⚠️ Elbow cresting shoulder line | Img1 Frame 2 (off arm), Img2 Frame 1 (sword arm) |
| 6 | ✅ No forearm inversion (wrong-side elbow) found in any frame |
| 7 | ✅ No arm-through-torso intersections found |
| 8 | ✅ No blade/leg or blade/ground intersections (blade largely hidden in silhouette — verify with visible-blade render) |

**Priority fix:** Img1-Frame-3 off arm, then Img2-Frame-3's dead arms — both look like missing or clamped rotation keys on the far-side arm at speed extremes.
